snippet.title: Flamecraft - Official Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
FLAMECRAFT RELEASES ON PC AND CONSOLES SEPTEMBER 17th!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201730/Flamecraft/
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/flamecraft-switch/
PlayStaton 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015125
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/flamecraft/9n007z5m8k0p

Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy game for 1 to 5 players. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enhance the shops by casting enchantments, and magic your way to becoming the best Flamekeeper.

Sign up to our newsletter on the official website: https://monstercouch.com/flamecraft
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/QyV2yKjnjJ

Follow us on social media to stay up-to-date:
